title: Display
text: Show value of input, 1 input, direct feedthrough, {Numeric display format} sets Format to display numeric input data; {Decimation} displays rate and {Floating display}. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Numeric display format
params.values: Format to display numeric input data short (default) | long | short_e | long_e | bank | hex (Stored Integer) | binary (Stored Integer) | decimal (Stored Integer) | octal (Stored Integer)
